cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Put It Back Quietly
cards.instruction: Return something you misplaced, used, or damaged without revealing why it needed restoring.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Your plate's back in the cupboard, ready for Sunday lunch. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That one's got flowers. Ours were plain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I'll take that one. The potatoes will cover the flowers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm not hiding it under potatoes. I want six matching plates.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll get five more before lunch. Keep the plain ones for spares; there's no need to count those today.

mechanism: A claims Sunday table arrangements are handled while progressively adopting B matching demands to hide why a replacement plate appeared.
confusable: Unlike buying new crockery openly, A avoids explaining the restored plain plate count; confidence bends to B aesthetic condition without admitting the loss.
comparison: Pattern mismatch and set replacement differ from physical contamination revealing an umbrella detour.
seedUse: Use D37-b replacement floral plate and six-matching demand with S02-b accommodating changed instructions; do not assert an unspoken break as fact.
